== Physical original source ==
The complete physical card prints “at same and related sites,” matching the game text retained here. The infobox now uses that existing physical scan.<ref>[[File:JP-L-artoo-hires.webp|Complete physical original]].</ref> The saved Decipher website face and its 17 August 2001 capture instead print “at related sites.”<ref>[[File:JP-L-artoo-decipher-archive.gif|Preserved website face]]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20010817020224id_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/jabbaspalace/light/images/artoo.gif complete Decipher website image, 17 August 2001].</ref> The 1998 Glossary’s entry retains “at same and related sites” within its clarified wording, which remains on [[Artoo (Jabba's Palace) (Errata)]].<ref>[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]], p. 14, Artoo.</ref> Released uses the physical Jabba’s Palace printing’s 29 April 1998 street date.<ref name="physical-original-publication">[[File:JP-L-artoo-hires.webp|Complete physical printed face]]; [https://web.archive.org/web/19980506103233id_/http://decipher.com:80/newsandhighlights/jpreleasedate.htm Decipher Jabba’s Palace worldwide street release announcement], worldwide street release, Wednesday, April 29, 1998.</ref> The existing website asset, physical asset, game text, lore, stats, card UID, article name and family entries are preserved.
